title: 金克丝 · 积木奇想
description: 蓝色长辫的金克丝穿宽松背带裤，专注搭一座歪歪的小积木屋。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayons with broken edges, scribbled fill and visible warm paper tooth
art_direction.palette: powder blue, lavender, coral pink, butter yellow, cream
art_direction.composition: Jinx from League of Legends reimagined as a cute fully clothed adult in a harmless everyday craft scene. Preserve her recognizable extremely long bright-blue twin braids curling softly on the floor, magenta eyes and mischievous broad smile. She wears a lavender long-sleeve shirt beneath roomy blue overalls, small fingerless fabric mitts and rounded pink sneakers; opaque comfortable coverage from shoulders to ankles, no exposed midriff. Sitting cross-legged on a warm crayon rug, she balances a single triangular yellow wooden block on top of a delightfully crooked pastel block house. One palm supports the house lightly; other fingers place the roof, with legible anatomy and no extra fingers. Only a few big blocks scattered nearby and a simple background shelf. Her eyebrows show playful concentration. No guns, rockets, ammunition, explosives, combat gear or destruction. Soft blue braids, lavender overalls and warm yellow roof.

visual_qa.method: six-image compressed JPEG contact sheet review, 1280x900
